\label{lesson:RU-C85-second}

\end{quote}

\section[dáta]{\ru{дата} (dáta) — a date}

\label{lesson:RU-C85-date}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for a second, then the Russian for the weekend.

A date needs an ordinal: say \emph{\ru{первый}, \ru{второй}, \ru{третий}}, and write the first as a sign writes it, \emph{1-\ru{й}}.
